- [GitHub Checks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/github-checks.md): Run an eval suite against the MCP server built from every pull reques
t, and read the result as a check run, a pull-request comment, and a machine-readable JSON block.
- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with l
ocal results and an MCPJam identity
- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI,
and other CI environments
- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-suite.md): API reference for EvalSuite
- [runSuiteFile](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md): API reference for running an MCPJam suite file locally
from code
- [Protocol Conformance SDK](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/protocol-conformance.md): Programmatic MCP protocol conformance
testing with MCPConformanceTest and MCPConformanceSuite
- [OAuth Conformance SDK](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/oauth-conformance.md): Programmatic OAuth conformance testing with
OAuthConformanceTest and OAuthConformanceSuite
- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run f
rom an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runI
d`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the h
osted UI Runs tab,…
- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest fi
rst.
- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.m
d): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value
chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host
